operator_gradient_discrepancy.configuration_note: Operator and road-paving supplier list4684m/16corners; Honda also repeats these gradient figures for4653m/15corners. None defines the gradient measurement interval.
operator_gradient_discrepancy.independent_review: Luna High checked CRS axis order, route scale, fixed origin and station-zero registration, Cascais datum and all containing local triangles. No concrete projection or datum error found. Coarse older Copernicus samples independently support the steep downhill; they do not resolve the short uphill.
operator_gradient_discrepancy.status: Open source-definition discrepancy. Local steepening is credible;100m aggregate grades roughly match the quoted figures, but this does not prove the operator used100m intervals. Do not claim the published maxima are satisfied, or flatten/rescale measured ground to force a match. Exact comparison needs a registered engineering profile or defined operator interval.
